correctness.rationale: Every closed subwalk on an accepting computation must have length divisible by m by pumping, and even by proper transition coloring; thus at least lcm(m,2) distinct early states occur. At equality a directed Hamilton cycle exists; cactus forbids chords, congruence forbids reverse steps/self-loops, completeness forces every letter on every forward arc, and final states are forced. Explicit construction meets bound.
